evals.prompt: Does the University of Michigan library have Ming-dynasty printed books with 明史 in the title? List the oldest ones and where they are shelved.
evals.expected_output: Alma SRU title search for 明史, sorted oldest first, with vernacular titles and AVA call numbers/locations
expectations: The Alma SRU endpoint was queried (umich.alma.exlibrisgroup.com/view/sru)
The query searched the title index for 明史
Results were sorted by publication date ascending or filtered to early dates
Titles are shown in Chinese characters (from 880 fields)
Call numbers and locations from AVA fields are given

evals.prompt: Find books by Timothy Brook at Michigan and tell me which ones I can read online.
evals.expected_output: Author search for Brook, Timothy with AVE electronic holdings identified
expectations: Results distinguish print (AVA) from online (AVE) holdings
Online platform or collection names are given for online items
Record links to search.lib.umich.edu are provided

evals.prompt: I found OCLC number 424023 in WorldCat. Does U-M hold it, and is there a digitized copy?
evals.expected_output: OCLC lookup in U-M Alma, then HathiTrust check for a digitized copy
expectations: The U-M record title and holdings are reported
The hathitrust-catalog skill or HathiTrust API was used for the digitized-copy question
